intended_object: A family of finite projective right modules over the matrix rings M_{κ j}(D j), indexed by j. Factor i is the row module D_i^{κ_i} and every other factor is the zero module. It is used to build the simple module supported at block i over a product of matrix rings, in the K-theory computation for semisimple rings. This was inferred from the docstring and from how the definition is used in Semisimple.lean.
explanation: The definition picks, for each index j, either the right row module (when j = i) or the zero module (otherwise). It does this as a dependently typed `if`, so that the family can be fed into `ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.piLinearEquiv` and the related lemmas (`matrixRowFactors_same` and `matrixRowFactors_of_ne`). The result is bookkeeping that packages the factors of the product module $0 \times \dots \times D_i^{\kappa_i} \times \dots \times 0$ over $\prod_j M_{\kappa_j}(D_j)$. Every use of it is inside proofs in the same file. It is an auxiliary construction for the proof that the K_0 of a semisimple ring is ℤ^ι, not a standard mathematical object with its own literature definition. As a construction it matches its docstring: block i holds the row module with its action supplied by `toRightMatrixModCat`, and every other block holds `PUnit`, the zero module.
